main.adb (the demo) did not compile: it called a nonexistent Compare/Compare_Primary/Initialize_DUCET and instantiated Vectors with indefinite String; make test never built it (sweep report; failing build commit)
Equalize_Global mapped uniform images (incl. 1x1) to 0 (0/0 case); tests 1-2 printed FAIL but make test exited 0 (silent-fail scan)

Standard build lacked -gnata so Pre contracts went unchecked (7 FAIL lines) and the final pragma Assert(Fail_Count = 0) was ignored; test 11.3 expected Conviction({1}->{9}) = 1.25 but the correct value is 1.0 (test bug) (silent-fail scan)

Packet_To_Send (out) never assigned when data was buffered (stale size read); Merge_Packets reported only the bytes before a partially copied packet (Remaining not zeroed) (silent-fail scan; 5 FAIL lines with exit 0)
Sending a merged MSS segment cleared the buffer: bytes past MSS and the new data were lost; test 14 expected no send with 2919 bytes buffered and window 2*MSS (contradicts RFC 896)

Test 9.1 relies on Train_Classifier Pre but make test had no -gnata: passed only when time-seeded sampling read past Labels (failed 12/30 runs on GNAT 14; final pragma Assert ignored so exit 0) (silent-fail scan)
XOR integration test (13.x) used time-seeded random initial weights and failed intermittently (GNAT 12 rerun; 1/40 reruns); exit 0 because the final pragma Assert was ignored without -gnata

Buffered packets are allocated with New_Data'Range but Merge_Packets indexes Pkg.Data(1 .. Size): a caller slice not starting at 1 raises Constraint_Error (code review; test 15 with Big (5 .. 7) and Big (10 .. 11))
Generator is time-seeded (Reset (Gen) at elaboration) so training and the rest of the suite are not reproducible run to run (observation)

Own checks called Gcd_Recursive with operands up to 10**17 although its Pre allows <= Max_Educational (1_000_000); make test had no -gnata so the violated precondition went unnoticed (alt held-out baseline in the -gnata build)

Cohen_Sutherland_Clip used strict outcode comparisons; a segment that grazes the window at a single corner (AA_SEED=3 / mapped seed 4) was Reject while the 4001-sample inside-part and Liang_Barsky_Clip Accept (flaky.py seed sweep, 15/30 seeds failed)
